g.text: Add the numbers 1 to 1,000, 40,000 times over: 40 million additions. The answer is 20,020,000,000.
8 threads, one shared sum, nothing else
8 threads, a sum each, added up at the end
8 threads, one shared sum, atomic additions
8 threads, one shared sum, a mutex around each
8 threads, one shared sum, a spinlock around each
Sharing made it wrong. Locking made it right, and slow. Not sharing made it right, and fast.
(bars grow with the square root of the time, or the last one would not fit)
